children: Bahrain’s Ministry of Works has received 7 bids for its construction tender for Sheikh Jaber Al Ahmad Al Sabah Highway Upgrade Project – Phase 1 Immediate Scheme.

The project involves the construction of a four-lane dual carriageway with service roads on both sides from the Nuwaidrat intersection to Applied Science University, covering approximately 2 kilometres.
The tender was issued on 12 May 2026, with the bid submission and opening dates extended from 12 and 13 July to 13 and 14 September 2026, respectively
· Mohammed Abdulmohsin Al-Kharafi & Sons for General Trading, General Contracting and Industrial Structures
· Eastern Asphalt and Mixed Concrete Co.
(Reporting by Deva Palanisamy; Editing by Anoop Menon)
